name: Goat and sheep farms

problems.words: Kitne bachay paida hue aur kitne mar gaye, koi hisaab nahi
quick_ideas: Write every birth and death the same day against the mother's tag
Ask the charwaha to send a photo for each, not just a call.

workzap_build.text: a kidding/lambing log on the phone that builds each doe's and ewe's record of births, twins and losses as entries come in.

problems.ask_first: Are the breeding does and ewes tagged today?
problems.free_stops: The log fields and performance view are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count this week's births and deaths against mothers you can identify, so you see where your herd record starts breaking.
Give one worker the job of noting every birth and death in one notebook the same day, so loss patterns stop getting missed.

problems.words: Headcount never matches between herder and manager
quick_ideas: Count at one fixed time every day
Count together at every handover so both agree the number.

workzap_build.text: a daily headcount sent with a photo, with a mismatch alert to the owner the same day.

problems.ask_first: Who counts the animals now, and how often?
problems.free_stops: Count timing and alert rules go in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare the herder count and manager count at evening lockup all week, so you see when the mismatch starts.
Give one person the final shed total after evening lockup in one notebook, so everyone works from the same number next morning.

problems.words: Animals stolen at night from the shed
quick_ideas: Do a dusk headcount after the bara is locked
Report every theft to the police and note when it happened.

workzap_build.text: timed night check-ins with headcount photos, alerting the owner straight away when one is missed.

problems.ask_first: At what time have losses usually happened?
problems.free_stops: Check-in times and alert routing are detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count animals at lockup and again at dawn for each shed block, so you see exactly where night losses are happening.
Give one person the job of writing every evening lockup count in one shed notebook, so the morning check starts from one trusted record.

problems.words: Feed and chara bills keep rising, I don't know cost per animal
quick_ideas: Put one month's feed, labour and vet bills against headcount for a rough cost per animal
Keep show or breeding animals' costs apart from the meat herd.

workzap_build.text: cost per animal and per batch worked out from the bills and headcounts the farm enters.

problems.ask_first: Do the goats graze, or are they fully stall-fed?
problems.free_stops: How costs are split between groups is worked out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare this week's fodder buying with the current headcount, so you see whether rising spend matches animals actually on the farm.
Keep fodder, labour and vet spending in one notebook page for the current herd, so your rough cost per animal is easier to judge.

problems.words: Sold Eid goats cheap because I didn't know what I'd spent on them
quick_ideas: Work out what each batch cost before Eid so you know your floor
Set a minimum price helpers can't go below without asking you.

workzap_build.text: dashboards_reports — an Eid sale catalogue with photos, weight and the owner's set price, shown next to each animal's running cost.

problems.ask_first: Who agrees the final price with buyers at Eid?
problems.free_stops: How the catalogue links to costs goes in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare what you spent on a sold batch with what came in, so you see which animals were let go too cheaply.
Give one person the job of noting each batch spend in one place before selling, so helpers stop guessing during Eid rush.

problems.words: Buyers DM at all hours, I lose them because I reply late
quick_ideas: Show price range, location and visiting times where buyers look first
Keep a list of who asked about which animal so nobody is forgotten.

workzap_build.text: Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp enquiries pulled into one list, with follow-up reminders sent on schedule.

problems.ask_first: Who replies to buyer messages now?
problems.free_stops: The follow-up rules and timings stay in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many buyer messages sat unanswered since morning and by evening, so you see the busiest reply gap clearly.
Give one person the job of checking buyer messages at fixed times daily, so interested visitors hear back while plans are fresh.

problems.words: Some buyers take animals on promise and pay months later
quick_ideas: Confirm each credit sale and due date to the buyer in writing
Decide your own limit on credit for new buyers.

workzap_build.text: a credit ledger that tracks every balance and sends polite reminders on its own before due dates.

problems.ask_first: How many buyers owe you right now?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing and limits go in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare promised payment dates with the animals already taken each market day, so you see which unpaid handovers are stretching the longest.
Give one person one notebook for every sale on promise and its due date, so collection follow up stays orderly each week.

problems.words: Breeding stock buyers ask for parent records and I have nothing
quick_ideas: Start a simple record for each breeding animal from what you know
Mark gaps as "not recorded" rather than guessing.

workzap_build.text: a shareable record card for each breeding animal, filled directly from the farm's own herd data.

problems.ask_first: Do you sell breeding animals often, or mainly for Eid?
problems.free_stops: The card's contents and how it's shared are set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Check how many breeding animals have known parents written anywhere today, so you see the size of the record gap.
Give one person one notebook for parent notes, tag details and buyer questions, so breeding stock discussions rely less on memory.

problems.words: Nobody checks water and feeding on time when I'm away
quick_ideas: Write down the daily tasks once, the way you already run the farm
Ask for a photo when each is done.

workzap_build.text: a daily care checklist with timestamps and photos that flags missed items to the owner straight away.

problems.ask_first: Who runs the farm day to day when you're not there?
problems.free_stops: The checklist itself and flag rules stay in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Walk the farm at the usual feeding and water times this week, so you see exactly which task slips when you are away.
Give one worker the job of ticking one paper list at the shed each day, so water and feeding checks happen on time.

problems.words: I keep everything in my head and can't hand over to my son
quick_ideas: Write down buyers, suppliers and what each animal is for
Let your son take over the daily records first.

workzap_build.text: Herd, buyer, supplier and cost records would sit in one place, updated daily, so a family successor could pick them up.

problems.ask_first: Is your son on the farm now, or in another job?
problems.free_stops: What is covered and how it's handed over goes in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note every task only you answer this week, so you see exactly which handovers block your son each day.
Give your son one notebook for buyer calls, shed counts and supplier notes, so farm updates stay in one place when you are away.

never_say: Any deworming, vaccine, medicine, feed recipe or breeding advice; suggest their vet.
Any ruling on qurbani suitability, or certification of breed purity; suggest their scholar or breed association.
Anything that helps falsify parentage, age or tags, or sell sick animals.
Promised Eid prices or herd growth.
Covert surveillance or confrontation advice about herders, or collecting IDs and bank details.

sample_reply.person: Mere paas 150 Beetal bakriyan hain, charwaha zubani batata hai kitne bachay hue aur kitne mare. Koi tareeqa batao.
sample_reply.pi:
Haan, is ko behtar kiya ja sakta hai, aur pehla qadam aasan hai.
Pehle, har paidaish aur maut usi din bakri ke tag ke saath likhi jaye.
Doosra, charwaha har aik ki photo bheje, sirf phone pe batana kaafi na ho.
Workzap is tarah ka intezam kar sakta hai: har bakri ka record phone pe bane, rozana ginti aaye, aur ginti na mile toh aap ko foran alert mile.
